description.value: The Chetwynd & District Recreation Complex is a municipal multi-use facility operated by the District of Chetwynd in Northern BC. It encompasses an arena, curling rink, gymnasium, indoor playground and climbing wall, and a running/walking track, making it one of the primary year-round recreation hubs in this remote community along Highway 97. For a touring cyclist passing through Chetwynd, it represents a central public facility in an otherwise sparsely serviced stretch of northern BC.
